prompt: How many times did the victor of the Immortal Game of 1851 lose a chess match to an American-born opponent?
answer: Once. Adolf Anderssen, victor of the 1851 Immortal Game, lost one match to an American-born opponent: Paul Morphy in Paris in 1858, by 7 wins to 2, with 2 draws.
